A. CALL TO ORDER – PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

B. APPROVAL OF AGENDA – ACTION

C. PUBLIC COMMENT Any person may address the Board for 3 minutes, and at the discretion of the Board President may be extended to 5 minutes on any subject within the jurisdiction of Tahoe City Public Utility District that does not appear elsewhere on the agenda. The Board will confer and decide upon one of the following but otherwise will not take any action: 1) Agree to continue discussion at another meeting by placing the subject on a future agenda; 2) Individual Board members may ask questions of staff; or 3) End public comment on the subject.

D. CONSENT CALENDAR

All items listed under the consent calendar-motions are considered to be routine and/or have been reviewed by committee, and will be approved by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a board member or staff person requests a specific item be removed from the consent calendar for separate consideration. Any item removed will be considered after the motion and vote to approve the remainder of consent calendar-motions.
